representation.name: miRNA Ct Welch tests with Bonferroni and BY
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 3) stop("Expected data matrix, sample metadata, and output path")
dat <- read.delim(args[1], header = TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE,
                  quote = "", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
meta <- read.delim(args[2], header = TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE,
                   quote = "", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (!("Group" %in% colnames(meta))) stop("Sample metadata lacks Group")
if (!all(rownames(meta) %in% rownames(dat))) stop("Sample IDs do not match")
dat <- dat[rownames(meta), , drop = FALSE]
grp <- as.character(meta$Group)
if (!setequal(unique(grp), c("Patient", "Control"))) stop("Expected Patient and Control groups")
if (sum(grp == "Patient") != 10 || sum(grp == "Control") != 10) stop("Unexpected group sizes")
mat <- as.matrix(dat)
storage.mode(mat) <- "double"
pvals <- vapply(seq_len(ncol(mat)), function(j) {
  t.test(mat[grp == "Patient", j], mat[grp == "Control", j],
         alternative = "two.sided", var.equal = FALSE)$p.value
}, numeric(1))
result <- data.frame(
  miRNA = colnames(mat),
  n_patient = sum(grp == "Patient"),
  n_control = sum(grp == "Control"),
  mean_patient_ct = colMeans(mat[grp == "Patient", , drop = FALSE]),
  mean_control_ct = colMeans(mat[grp == "Control", , drop = FALSE]),
  p_value = pvals,
  p_bonferroni = p.adjust(pvals, method = "bonferroni"),
  p_BY = p.adjust(pvals, method = "BY"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
write.table(result, file = args[3], sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript analysis.R "$(inputs.data_matrix.path)" "$(inputs.sample_metadata.path)" result.tsv

events.command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 3) stop("Expected data matrix, sample metadata, and output path")
dat <- read.delim(args[1], header = TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE,
                  quote = "", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
meta <- read.delim(args[2], header = TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE,
                   quote = "", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (!("Group" %in% colnames(meta))) stop("Sample metadata lacks Group")
if (!all(rownames(meta) %in% rownames(dat))) stop("Sample IDs do not match")
dat <- dat[rownames(meta), , drop = FALSE]
grp <- as.character(meta$Group)
if (!setequal(unique(grp), c("Patient", "Control"))) stop("Expected Patient and Control groups")
if (sum(grp == "Patient") != 10 || sum(grp == "Control") != 10) stop("Unexpected group sizes")
mat <- as.matrix(dat)
storage.mode(mat) <- "double"
pvals <- vapply(seq_len(ncol(mat)), function(j) {
  t.test(mat[grp == "Patient", j], mat[grp == "Control", j],
         alternative = "two.sided", var.equal = FALSE)$p.value
}, numeric(1))
result <- data.frame(
  miRNA = colnames(mat),
  n_patient = sum(grp == "Patient"),
  n_control = sum(grp == "Control"),
  mean_patient_ct = colMeans(mat[grp == "Patient", , drop = FALSE]),
  mean_control_ct = colMeans(mat[grp == "Control", , drop = FALSE]),
  p_value = pvals,
  p_bonferroni = p.adjust(pvals, method = "bonferroni"),
  p_BY = p.adjust(pvals, method = "BY"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
write.table(result, file = args[3], sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
RSCRIPT
